column1: # What the suite is expected to examine. Raise a number in the same commit that
# earns it; lower one only with a reason in the commit message.
# A green run proves nothing on its own: a gate that collects zero tests exits
# exactly as successfully as one that ran everything.
# Windows records three skipped test cases (plus three skipped subcases); Linux CI requires all 22.
# Original-input DarkScript compilation is an additional local-only test.
